elements_selected.content: REQ-513 / CON-513 / TEST-513: prove `theorem verify_all_is_meet : ∀ M (preds : List Predecessor) S, verify M (CausalProtocol.all preds) S = preds.foldr (fun p acc => verify M p S ⊓ acc) ⊤` in Verify.lean. Induction over predecessor list; appeal to associativity of meet from the BoundedLattice instance (REQ-510). This is the structural form that lets eventual-consistency follow via lattice-homomorphism rather than re-induction.
